plan: Queue jungle as primary. It is Willy's best role at 51.3% over 163 games (overall is 50.6%). Set support as secondary, not the other way around.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Zinx. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 3.6 more games per 100 on it.
Willy's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 46% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 503 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Willy wins the long game
insights.finding: Past 32 minutes Willy wins 78% vs 53% in short games. Scaling comps and patience fit; avoid coin-flip early all-ins.
insights.receipt: wins 9 of 17 short games vs 7 of 9 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Willy
insights.finding: Right after a loss Willy wins 46%; right after a win, 59%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 6/13 after losses vs 10/17 after wins, last 31 games

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Willy's best
insights.finding: Willy's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 327 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: Gadget is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 224 games on Gadget at 50.6% — the field averages 49.7%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 1 pentakill in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 23 (plus 1 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Willy has receipts.

coachReasoning.assessment: Willy's recent wins came from controlled games — 1 death on Skylar against a 3 norm, 22 wards on Mourn, 8 on Zarus — while both offlane games ran hot: 5 deaths on Greystone against a 2 norm and 4 on Shinbi against the same 2. The lever is how the melee front-line games get entered, not how many games get played.
plan: On Greystone, stop opening fights with Assault The Gates. Lead with Make Way to wear down their armor and swing the empowered, cleaving Sacred Oath attack from the edge of the fight, then keep the leap for getting back out — the 2/5/1 loss ran 5 deaths against a 2 norm, and jumping in first is exactly what that scoreline looks like.

Also on Greystone: fire Stone Forged Soul while getting collapsed on, not saved for a kill. The stasis restores more health the more health is already missing, so it is worth burning in the bad fight rather than dying with it still up.

On Shinbi, get the shield up before contact — cast Circle Rhythm first, then dash in with Rushing Beat. Every ability that lands on a hero also builds Track toward All-Kill!, so poking with Line Tempo from range charges the ultimate without paying the 4 deaths the last Shinbi game did.

On Zinx, keep chipping with basic attacks and Bad Medicine — those hits build Triage Protocol stacks, and at full stacks the next Infuse heals for far more. Hit the minute-15 Oblivion Crown spike on time and take Vesh (+13.5% on the damage rotation at minute 15); the third item lands around minute 27, which suits the long games Willy already wins.

On Skylar, set the slow before the burst: Plasma Grenade onto the target, then Hypercharge while they are stuck in it, and use Air Assault for the extra attack range while hovering rather than as an escape button. That is the 3/1/4 game repeated on purpose.

insights.title: The deaths are in the melee games
insights.finding: The only loss in the set is also the highest-death game — Greystone at 5 against a 2 norm — while the Skylar win came in at 1 death against a 3 norm. Same week, same player: the ranged games are being played at a much safer distance than the melee ones.

insights.title: Vision already travels
insights.finding: Willy wards above the bar when the role asks for it — 22 wards on Mourn against a 9 norm, 8 on Zarus against a 6 norm. Carrying that same map awareness into the Greystone and Shinbi games is the cheapest fix available for those death counts.

insights.title: Zinx's clock matches Willy's games
insights.finding: Past 32 minutes Willy wins 78% versus 53% in short games, and Zinx's third item does not land until around minute 27. Picking Zinx and playing for the long game lines the hero's timing up with the games Willy actually closes.

insights.title: Offlane is the leak, jungle is the outlet
insights.finding: Offlane sits at 42.2% over 147 games and produced both high-death games in this set, while the jungle game in the same stretch was the 7/2/8 Zarus win. Moving those offlane games to jungle is priced at +2.6 wins per 100.
